name: Super Soldier Rebirth
effectText: Target 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster you control; send it to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster from your hand with a different name from that monster, ignoring its Summoning conditions. During your Main Phase, except the turn this card was sent to the GY: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Black Luster Soldier" monster in your GY; add it to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Super Soldier Rebirth" per turn.
